facts.fact: Lei n.º 15/2017 (Lei sobre Cibercrime), passed by the Assembleia Nacional on 28 June 2017, promulgated on 3 August 2017 and published in the Diário da República on 6 October 2017, creates computer-crime offences and procedural powers and enters into force 30 days after publication (about 5 November 2017).
